findings.title: Evidence records meas-known-bad failing while the scored verdict says it passed
findings.detail: Recorded runs said ok:false while results/app-builder.json recorded passed:true for the same commit. Resolved by re-gating after the fixes below, so evidence and verdict are produced by the same run.

findings.title: fe-legal-substance is browser-driven but was excluded from BROWSER_DRIVEN_RULES
findings.detail: Its own metadata says tool playwright, engine chromium, yet meas-two-run never evaluated it, and its two runs were byte-identical to the millisecond. Rubric row D8 is bound to it, so a row required to be measured twice was measured once and recorded twice. FIXED: added to BROWSER_DRIVEN_RULES, which immediately exposed the duplicate; both write sites now record two genuinely independent measurements.
